\textbf{\(c_1\) Scope and Deliverables Definition.}
Explicit Scope and Deliverables: The scope of this Control Account (CA) is highly defined, and all associated deliverables are explicitly detailed and directly relevant to the program. Clear Alignment: The clear mapping between the work scope and concrete outputs provides a high level of transparency, significantly reducing execution risk and establishing a solid baseline for progress tracking.\par\vspace{0.6em}
\textbf{\(c_2\) Schedule Planning and IMS-Loading Readiness.}
Direct Schedule Traceability: The product and deliverable defined within this Control Account (CA) is highly explicit, enabling them to be directly and clearly mapped to schedule planning activities. IMS Readiness: This clear articulation provides a robust foundation that fully supports immediate IMS-loading readiness, ensuring progress can be accurately tracked against a reliable baseline.\par\vspace{0.6em}
\textbf{\(c_3\) Cross-Product/Cross-Function Integration.}
Comprehensive Product Scope: The scope successfully covers all GDMS products, ensuring the baseline work is captured at a high level. Missing Integration Framework: Confidence is capped at Moderate because the planning does not specifically address cross-product or cross-functional integration. While the individual products are covered, the structural interfaces and dependencies between them remain undefined.\par\vspace{0.6em}
